title: Shardnest Scrounger
text: Shardnest Scrounger builds a glittering nest from stripped mechanisms and defends each stolen spring as an egg. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The nest clicks even when the creature sleeps.

defeatReward.text: Shardnest Scrounger is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
